command:
set -u
for p in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$p/noexec-probe"
  chmod 755 "$p/noexec-probe"
  "$p/noexec-probe" >/dev/null 2>&1
  exec_rc=$?
  rm -f "$p/noexec-probe"
  mknod "$p/nodev-probe" c 1 3
  dd if="$p/nodev-probe" of=/dev/null bs=1 count=1 >/dev/null 2>&1
  dev_rc=$?
  rm -f "$p/nodev-probe"
  printf '%s noexec_probe_rc=%s nodev_probe_rc=%s\n' "$p" "$exec_rc" "$dev_rc"
done
printf '%s\n' '--- kernel mount records ---'
awk '$5=="/tmp" || $5=="/dev/shm" {print}' /proc/self/mountinfo
